notes: Executors drive end to end and escalate to the advisor only when they hit a decision they cannot reasonably settle. Frontier reasoning is applied where it changes the outcome, not to every token of every task.
gpt-6.1-sol is reserved for roles that judge rather than execute: the advisor itself and the review roles whose findings can block a release (security, rai, fact-checker), each called on demand.
2026-10-19: lead moved to claude-sonnet-5.5. The lead coordinates every session, so it ran the whole Squad on ACA session on the frontier model; it now escalates hard calls to advisor instead.
claude-haiku-5.5 runs scribe and docs. Both are high volume and low ambiguity.
defaultModel is claude-sonnet-5.5 so a NEW agent added later lands on the executor tier by default rather than silently inheriting the judgement tier.
Every agent is listed explicitly even where it matches defaultModel, because Layer 0a beats Layer 0b and an unlisted agent is easy to misread as deliberate.

Keys are exact, case-sensitive member names: the lowercase .squad/agents/<name>/ folder, which is also the casting registry key and the spawn name. A display-cased key such as Rai or Scribe never matches and silently falls through to defaultModel.

The after-agent Scribe spawn must pass scribeModel explicitly. The vendored .squad/templates/after-agent-reference.md hardcodes an older Scribe model; .github/agents/squad.agent.md overrides it for this repository.
If a configured model is unavailable, stop and report which member and model. Do not downgrade silently and do not omit the model parameter.

LIMITATION, measured: Anthropic advisor tool performs the handoff inside a single API request. Squad cannot. An agent needing another agent must end its turn and let the coordinator bring one in, so each escalation costs a round trip. See .squad/agents/advisor/charter.md.

Superseded 2026-10-09 (issue #246): the earlier model mapping and its 2026-08-04 availability note are preserved as a superseded entry in .squad/decisions.md and no longer apply. claude-sonnet-5.5, claude-haiku-5.5 and gpt-6.1-sol are the ids Brian authorised and were listed by the Copilot CLI on 2026-10-09.
